Method of Attack: Enables malicious code executed on one CPU core to leak data from software executed on a different core by compromising the CPU’s random number generator and overwriting the shared buffer before reuse.
Discoverer: VUSec, the Systems and Network Security Group at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
Impacted Systems: Intel processors employing RDRAND and/or RDSEED random number generators
Attack Vector: Exploitation of the CPU’s random number generator and shared buffer
